explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX;)

a:

this is the solution i came up with:
$result = 'XXXXX in english';

$XXXXXzone = 'utc';

$date = str_replace($result, '', $date);

$date = date_create($date, $XXXXXzone);

$result = date_format($date, str_XXXXXstamp). " ". $XXXXXzone;

echo $result;
